reason: Not refuted. Checked against the source: calculate_mover_x_max_and_y_max ends STA mover_x_max_low : RTS (game.6502:3604-3605), so A is mover_x_max_low after the JSR and LDX first_mover does not change it. check_for_mover_collision_with_range_of_movers has one caller (game.6502:3049, enter_or_leave_helicopter), which stores last_mover = &17 just before, so &1A is right. Its X (&21) and Y are untouched and it reads mover_x_max_low as the old code did. On the movers' and player's path last_mover = &FF is stored just above with nothing writing it in between, so the constant 2 is &FF+3 mod 256. The carry the old ADC left is dead: set_cm_left starts LDA/SEC. The new rare entry sits after skeleton_height's RTS, so nothing falls into it. The changed bytes are the game's own variables (&B6/&B7/&C5-&C7 as before) and its self-modified operands. No PROTECTED, generated, table, raster or other-bank code is touched; no ROMSEL, ANDY or ACCCON-X dependence. Assembled in a scratch copy: the shipping, DEBUG_FULLREDRAW=1, SKY_HELI=0, both of those, and the full gameplay flag set all assemble. unused_3400_original goes from &333F to &3343 (shipping), and the DEBUG_FULLREDRAW/SKY_HELI=0 builds now reach &3400 exactly (0 free). The SHIFT=256 SHIFT_END=1 DEBUG_LIVES builds fail ('bank 5 overruns its 16K by 239') with the unmodified source too, so that failure is older than the candidate. The collision loop moves to &24CD-&24F7, still in page &24. The BRA at &249C to &24C0 stays in the same page. BEQ cfc_a_leave_clear (&254D to &2549) stays in the same page. Count: hot path old LDA zp/CLC/ADC#/STA abs/LDA zp/STA abs = 18 cycles, 13 bytes; new STA abs/LDA #/STA abs = 10 cycles, 8 bytes, plus a 9-byte rare entry (LDA zp, STA abs, LDA #, BRA): 8 cycles saved a call, 4 bytes more in all.
